ModMetaData.name: Dawn of a New Day
ModMetaData.author: AlenDio
ModMetaData.description: Adds a customizable header overlay that displays at the start of the day. Settings Go to: Options > Mod options > "Dawn of a New Day" Translation - English: Original (author). - Italian: author. - Chinese Simplified: hotaru-hoshizora. - Russian: dzirtikk. NOTE: If you want to contribute, check the mod description from Steam Workshop. Mod Compatibility - Modern Notifications: Added formats and texts for Reminders and Occasions. Latest Patch # v2.0.1 - Optimized performance during overlay + 1.6: ~0.4 ms/frame -> ~0.1 ms/frame. + 1.7: ~0.05 ms/frame -> ~0.03 ms/frame. Can be safely added or removed from existing saves at any time.
